CREATE TABLE "public"."clinic_departments" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), "branch_id" uuid NOT NULL, "active" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, "code" text NOT NULL, "legacy_id" text NULL, "name" text NOT NULL, "public_booking_enabled" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, "sort_order" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "clinic_departments_branch_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("branch_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_branches" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clinic_doctor_departments" ("doctor_id" uuid NOT NULL, "department_id" uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("doctor_id", "department_id"), CONSTRAINT "clinic_doctor_departments_department_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("department_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_departments" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT "clinic_doctor_departments_doctor_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("doctor_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_doctors" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clinic_doctor_schedules" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), "doctor_id" uuid NOT NULL, "end_minute" integer NOT NULL, "start_minute" integer NOT NULL, "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, "weekday" integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "clinic_doctor_schedules_doctor_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("doctor_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_doctors" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clinic_schedule_exceptions" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), "doctor_id" uuid NOT NULL, "date" date NOT NULL, "kind" text NOT NULL, "public_note" text NULL, "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "clinic_schedule_exceptions_doctor_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("doctor_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_doctors" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clinic_exception_windows" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), "exception_id" uuid NOT NULL, "end_minute" integer NOT NULL, "start_minute" integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "clinic_exception_windows_exception_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("exception_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_schedule_exceptions" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clinic_staff_profiles" ("user_id" text NOT NULL, "doctor_id" uuid NULL, "active" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, "requires_password_change" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"), CONSTRAINT "clinic_staff_profiles_user_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_users" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT "clinic_staff_profiles_doctor_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("doctor_id") REFERENCES "public"."clinic_doctors" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL)
